objective: Avoid a full normalized-text copy for compatible R2007+ DXF MTEXT with line breaks while preserving wire chunking, strict-lossless behavior, and legacy conversion.

behavior: Lazily maps LF and CRLF into the two-byte MTEXT paragraph marker while consuming normalized bytes for chunking.
Builds only the encoded chunk backing string and chunk ranges for the selected identity-mapped modern compatible route.
Preserves chunk byte/character limits, group ordering, and the existing short-final-group behavior.
Rejects a lone CR before emitting any group; strict-lossless and pre-AC1021 paths use the prior logic.
implementation.compatibility: The route is gated to compatible DXF output at AC1021 or later with line-break input. No installed API, public class layout, callback, or default wire behavior changed.

controls: Generated ASCII and Binary A-LF-B-CRLF-C input with an exact three-byte/three-character group boundary and expected group-3/group-1 output.
Generated ASCII/Binary byte-for-byte A/B comparison against the existing chunker fed independently normalized text across several byte/character ceilings, LF/CRLF combinations, and multibyte inputs.
Generated AC1032 multibyte UTF-8 case verifies scalar integrity at a chunk boundary and the short-final-group rule.
Generated lone-CR case verifies failure before output bytes.
limits: No allocator-count, throughput, or peak-RSS measurement was run; copy avoidance is established by source structure and wire-equivalence controls.
Malformed UTF-8 remains subject to the existing compatible-mode behavior and is not qualified by this slice.
No full suite, peer runtime, native CAD application, or fuzz/sanitizer campaign was run.
